# Using Art Director in OpenCode

<!-- Generated by `node packages/cli build` from the harness registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

The skill is the same in every agent. This guide covers only what is specific to OpenCode.

## Install

Project scope (one repository): copy this skill folder to `.opencode/skills/artdirector/`.

User scope (every project): copy it to `~/.config/opencode/skills/artdirector/`.

From the gti-skills repository, the CLI does the copy for you:

```bash
node packages/cli install --harness opencode --skill artdirector
node packages/cli install --harness opencode --skill artdirector --scope user
```

Restart the agent session after installing so it rescans its skills.

## Use

Describe the task in plain language. OpenCode loads the skill when the request matches its `description`. You can also name it in the request, for example: "Use the artdirector skill to ...".

## Where the skill finds its files

`<skill-dir>` in `SKILL.md` is the folder that contains `SKILL.md`: `.opencode/skills/artdirector` for a project install, or `~/.config/opencode/skills/artdirector` for a user install. Scripts and references are always addressed relative to it.

## Verify

Ask the agent which skills it has loaded and check that `artdirector` is listed.

## Notes

- OpenCode also reads .claude/skills and .agents/skills.
- This skill drives the packages/artdirector engine. Build it once, and set ARTDIRECTOR_HOME to its folder if you copied the skill folder by hand instead of using the install command.
- Installing at project scope also adds the /artdirector command to .opencode/commands/, which starts a new artwork request.
- Documentation: [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai/docs/skills/) (path source: official).
